# Kirtan Chandak — Full Context

> Software developer at Kuration AI, building AI agents, MCP servers, and developer tooling. Google Summer of Code contributor and LFX intern at Vitess (Linux Foundation).

## Bio

Kirtan Chandak is a software developer based in Pune, India. He currently works at Kuration AI as a Founding Engineer, where he builds AI agents, MCP servers, and developer tooling.

He was a Google Summer of Code (GSoC) contributor with OpenFoodFacts and a Linux Foundation (LFX) mentee with Vitess. He is a Microsoft Student Ambassador and was the Lead of the Microsoft Learn Student Club at GHRCEM.

Most of his time goes into building AI agents, exploring new products, and contributing to open source projects. He writes code at odd hours and ships things that mostly work.

He is always up for good conversations and can be reached at kirtanmchandak5@gmail.com.

## Projects

### groundtruth
An autonomous AI data steward that continuously audits enterprise databases.
- Repository: https://github.com/kirtanchandak/groundtruth

### baton
Keeps context alive across async agent handoffs. Built for Slack.
- Repository: https://github.com/flex3-org/baton

## Side Projects

### llmbuys
An AI agent skill that audits your website by testing what AI says about your product to customers.
- Repository: https://github.com/kirtanchandak/llmbuys

### rant
A brain dump and private journal with pgvector search so old notes come back when you need them.
- Repository: https://github.com/kirtanchandak/rant

### weekend.warrior
A retro-themed GitHub analyzer that tracks your weekend commits with a CRT aesthetic.
- Repository: https://github.com/kirtanchandak/weekend.warrior
